name: Marked Arrows
body:
School enchantment; Level adept 0, ranger 1, sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target up to 10 non-magic arrows or bolts
Duration 1 hour/level
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You enchant projectiles so you can easily find them after firing. The chance of finding this ammo increases to 75% for missed shots. Marked arrows that strike their target lose this enchantment even if not destroyed.
